tools.name: helpwise_list_conversations
tools.description: List conversations (threads) of one or more inboxes, newest first, with subject, snippet, tags, assignee, read/starred/closed flags and contact. Pick the folder with `folder` (default: all). Page with `next_page_token`. Inbox ids come from helpwise_list_inboxes. GET /conversations.

tools.name: helpwise_get_conversation
tools.description: One conversation with its messages, notes, drafts, assignment and contacts. Page long conversations with `page_token` from the previous reply. GET /inboxes/{inbox_id}/conversations/{conversation_id}.

tools.name: helpwise_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (name, company, job title, emails, phones, id). Page with limit and offset. GET /contacts.

tools.name: helpwise_search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by a name, email or phone term. Page with limit and offset. GET /contacts/search.

tools.name: helpwise_get_contact
tools.description: One contact with emails, phones, company, custom fields and recent conversations. GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: helpwise_list_tags
tools.description: All tags (id, name, colour, parent, inbox). Use the ids with helpwise_apply_tags. GET /tags.

tools.name: helpwise_get_tag
tools.description: One tag by id. GET /tags/{id}.

tools.name: helpwise_get_report
tools.description: Overall and team-performance report for a date range: new/closed/assigned conversations (with change vs the previous period), inbound/outbound messages per day, busiest hour/day, average first response, response and resolution time, CSAT and per-agent performance. Optional inbox and tag filters. GET

tools.name: helpwise_get_tags_report
tools.description: Per-tag report for one inbox and a date range: conversations per tag (and share), open conversations, average response, first-response and resolution time. GET /inboxes/{inbox_id}/reports/tags.

tools.name: helpwise_list_inboxes
tools.description: List the account's inboxes (mailboxes) with id, name, address and type. Use the ids in the other tools. POST /mailboxes/list (V0).

tools.name: helpwise_list_users
tools.description: List the team members (agents) with access to an inbox: id, name, email. Use the ids with helpwise_assign_conversation. POST /users/list (V0).

tools.name: helpwise_get_current_user
tools.description: The Helpwise user the API key belongs to (name, email, id). POST /users/me (V0).

tools.name: helpwise_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a new contact in Helpwise (name, company, job title, emails, phones, custom fields). Nothing is sent to the person. Creating the same email twice may create a duplicate. POST /contacts.

tools.name: helpwise_update_contact
tools.description: WRITE: change a contact's name, company, job title, emails, phones or custom fields. Helpwise updates with PUT, so this tool first reads the contact and sends the current values together with your changes; a list you pass (emails, phones, custom_fields) REPLACES the old list. Nothing is sent to the

tools.name: helpwise_add_note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a conversation. Visible to your Helpwise team only; it is not sent to the customer. Notes cannot be deleted through this API. POST /notes/add (V0).

tools.name: helpwise_assign_conversation
tools.description: WRITE: assign a conversation to a team member (user id from helpwise_list_users), or pass assigned_to 0 to unassign it. The assignee may be notified by Helpwise. POST /threads/assign (V0).

tools.name: helpwise_close_conversations
tools.description: WRITE: close up to 25 conversations (mark them done). They can be reopened with helpwise_reopen_conversations. Nothing is sent to customers. PUT /conversations/action/close.

tools.name: helpwise_reopen_conversations
tools.description: WRITE: move up to 25 conversations back to the inbox (reopen closed ones). Nothing is sent to customers. PUT /conversations/action/moveToInbox.

tools.name: helpwise_apply_tags
tools.description: WRITE: apply existing tags (ids from helpwise_list_tags) to up to 25 conversations. Tags can drive Helpwise automations. Applying a tag already present changes nothing. POST /tags/apply.

tools.name: helpwise_remove_tags
tools.description: WRITE: take tags off up to 25 conversations. The tags themselves are not deleted. POST /tags/remove.

tools.name: helpwise_send_email
tools.description: WRITE: SEND A REAL EMAIL from a Helpwise inbox to the given customer address(es). Irreversible; once sent it cannot be recalled. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: helpwise_list_conversations, helpwise_get_conversation, helpwise_list_contacts, helpwise_search_contacts, helpwise_get_contact, helpwise_list_tags, helpwise_get_report, helpwise_get_tags_report, helpwise_list_inboxes, helpwise_list_users, helpwise_get_current_user, helpwise_update_contact · Private data: helpwise_list_conversations, helpwise_get_conversation, helpwise_list_contacts, helpwise_search_contacts, helpwise_get_contact, helpwise_get_current_user, helpwise_create_contact, helpwise_update_contact · Public sink: helpwise_search_contacts, helpwise_get_tags_report, helpwise_list_inboxes, helpwise_list_users, helpwise_get_current_user, helpwise_create_contact, helpwise_add_note, helpwise_assign_conversation, helpwise_apply_tags, helpwise_remove_tags, helpwise_send_email · Destructive: helpwise_remove_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: helpwise_list_conversations, helpwise_get_conversation, helpwise_list_contacts, helpwise_search_contacts, helpwise_get_contact, helpwise_list_tags, helpwise_get_report, helpwise_get_tags_report, helpwise_list_inboxes, helpwise_list_users, helpwise_get_current_user, helpwise_update_contact · Private data: helpwise_list_conversations, helpwise_get_conversation, helpwise_list_contacts, helpwise_search_contacts, helpwise_get_contact, helpwise_get_current_user, helpwise_create_contact, helpwise_update_contact · Public sink: helpwise_search_contacts, helpwise_get_tags_report, helpwise_list_inboxes, helpwise_list_users, helpwise_get_current_user, helpwise_create_contact, helpwise_add_note, helpwise_assign_conversation, helpwise_apply_tags, helpwise_remove_tags, helpwise_send_email · Destructive: helpwise_remove_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
